title: Upload queue
offline: Offline. Uploading resumes on its own when the connection is back.
online_hint: Photos and signatures are saved on the device first, then sent in the background. The queue survives closing the app.
empty_body: No photo or signature is waiting to be sent.
remove_confirm_body: This item is deleted from the device and will not be sent.
error_file_missing: The file is no longer on the device. Take the photo again.
error_too_large: The file is larger than allowed.
